units.source_text: 铁锹和油桶并排靠在外墙上。

en.t: The shovel and the oil drum were leaning side by side against the outer wall.

units.source_text: 铁锹圆圆的头被磨得锋利无比，像打碎的濑户陶器的破口，闪着白光。

en.t: The shovel's rounded blade had been ground to an extraordinary sharpness, gleaming white like the broken edge of shattered Seto pottery.
